primary_endpoint: 16-shot conditional MAE reduction, selected classical baseline minus augmented neural meta-adapter
limitations: Conditional participant-level bootstrap and sign-flip tests average errors across 20 overlapping support draws. They do not capture retraining uncertainty, uncertainty from choosing the support pool, or independent-cohort population inference. The 32-shot PBMC experiments reuse the entire 32-person pool; only CV partition assignment varies. Source datasets were previously studied, but external query cohorts were not used for model design or tuning.
